title: When the Garden Sings Anew
author: O. M. Thackeray
blurb: Lior Okonkwo, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
